name: update-download-install-handoff
title: 应用内更新下载与安装交接优化
description: 让更新弹窗、下载进度与安装交接形成连续体验；Windows 自动拉起安装器，Android 自动拉起系统安装确认界面。
creator: cfl
notes: Download/install use single-flight operations, .part commit, GitHub SHA-256 verification before commit/install, verified-package reuse, and retry-preserving failures. Windows waits for the Inno Setup process; UAC cancellation or non-zero exit preserves the verified package and exposes retry without a fixed-delay duplicate-install window. Updater tests pass (21), the full Flutter suite passes (231 passed, 1 skipped), analysis and Windows release build pass, and MuMu Android 0.6.1-to-0.6.2 system-installer smoke passed. Windows desktop UI/UAC smoke remains pending because Computer Use was stopped during target selection. The unrelated installed D:\RCH\RCH.exe v0.5.7 was not counted as a test.
